technical-data.invention-title: METHOD FOR DISINFECTING AND PURIFYING LIQUIDS AND GASSES
PROCEDE DE DESINFECTION ET DE PURIFICATION DE LIQUIDES ET GAZ

nplcit.text: TYNER C E: "APPLICATION OF SOLAR THERMAL TECHNOLOGY TO THE DESTRUCTION OF HAZARDOUS WASTES" SOLAR ENERGY MATERIALS,NL,ELSEVIER SCIENCE PUBLISHERS B.V. AMSTERDAM, vol. 21, no. 2 / 03, 1 December 1990 (1990-12-01), pages 113-129, XP000178729

abstract.p: The present invention relates to a method for disinfecting and purifying liquids and gasses comprising: a) passing said liquids or gasses through a reactor or a combination of reactors, having a truncated compounded concentrator geometry; and b) simultaneously delivering and concentrating diversified electromagnetic and acoustic energies into a specific predetermined inner space of said compounded concentrator reactor, forming a high energy density zone in said reactor or reactors over a predetermined period of time. The reactor according to the present invention is preferably a compounded parabolic concentrator or a compounded ellipsoidal concentrator. The electromagnetic energy delivered and concentrated into and inside the reactor can be of any range of the electromagnetic spectrum, such as ultra-violet, visible, infra-red, microwave etc., or combination thereof. The acoustic energy is of any suitable frequency. The radiation source delivering the electromagnetic radiation can be enclosed within the reactor or can be external to the reactor.

L'invention concerne un procédé de désinfection et de purification de liquides et de gaz qui consiste à: a) passer lesdits liquides ou gaz dans un réacteur, ou une combinaison de réacteurs, présentant une géométrie de concentrateur composé tronquée; et b) fournir et concentrer simultanément des énergies électromagnétiques et sonores diversifiées dans un volume intérieur prédéterminé spécifique dudit réacteur concentrateur composé, avec formation d'une zone à densité d'énergie élevée dans le(s) réacteur(s) pendant une durée prédéterminée. Le réacteur est de préférence un concentrateur parabolique ou ellipsoïdal composé. L'énergie électromagnétique fournie et concentrée dans et à l'intérieur du réacteur peut appartenir à toutes les gammes du spectre électromagnétique, ultraviolet, visible, infrarouge, micro onde, etc., ou leur combinaison. La fréquence de l'énergie sonore doit être appropriée. La source de rayonnement fournissant le rayonnement électromagnétique peut être enfermée à l'intérieur du réacteur ou être à l'extérieur de celui-ci.

description.p: METHOD FOR DISINFECTING AND PURIFYING LIQUIDS AND GASSES
FIELD OF THE INVENTION

The present invention relates to a method for simultaneously disinfecting and purifying liquids and gasses. More specifically the present invention relates to a method for disinfecting and purifying liquids and gasses by passing said liquids and/or gasses through a reactor of compounded concentrator geometry, more specifically of a compounded parabolic concentrator, and simultaneously concentrating a plurality of launched and/or delivered, and/or diversified energies in motion into a specific predetermined inner space of said reactor forming a high energy density zone. Said energies include acoustic and/or ultrasonic transient cavitation and electromagnetic energy from a variety of ranges selected from the electromagnetic spectrum (e.g. ultra-violet, visible, infra-red, microwave etc.).

The inner surface of the reactor is preferably covered by a thin layer of photo catalyst such as titanium oxide and said inner surface is optionally grooved, or sub-wavelength synthesized by a predetermined holographic grooving pattern to facilitate wavelength dependent reflection and/or refraction and/or diffraction or any combination thereof.

The present invention further relates to the concentrator according to said method (hereinafter called hydrodynamic Compounded Parabolic Concentrator, or HDCPC) and to arrays of such concentrators interconnected either serially or in parallel or in a combination thereof.
BACKGROUND OF THE INVENTION

Global need for efficient water disinfecting technologies is indisputable. Disinfecting technologies favor UV technology over the use of disinfecting chemicals, due to strict legislation on disinfectants and disinfecting by-products. UV light produced by
legislation on disinfectants and disinfecting by-products. UV light produced by conventional lamps is the principle means for generating UV energy with its non-residual effects creating no harmful compounding volumes (e.g. in comparison to chlorinating processes). These lamps are arranged in banks of lamps, often immersed in channels (or reactors) each hosting large number of said lamps. The lamps (e.g. such as mercury arc and vapor lamps require expensive periodical replacement and maintenance. Current limitation imposed by the use of conventional lamp based reactors stem from their inability to combat colloidal deposits and/or hard water deposits efficiently. Further more, the use of protecting sleeves (e.g. quartz sleeves are known for their ability to transmit deep UV 200nm to 320nm) to ensure adequate protection for the lamps is increasing the cost further, often requiring allocation of additional much needed resources as well as making it hard for designers, producers and/or end users to take advantage of an optical or acoustic concentrator orientation for reactors. The present invention is not so limited, that's why the present invention could be used for a wide variety of disinfecting, neutralizing, dissolving and deodorizing applications wherein liquids or gasses are treated.

The aim of the present invention is to provide a highly efficient method for disinfecting and purifying liquids and gasses by passing liquids and/or gasses through a compounded concentrator and simultaneously concentrating diversified electromagnetic and acoustic, ultrasonic (transient cavitation) energies into a high energy density and concentration zone where the disinfecting or inactivation of DNA and RNA replication sequences (e.g. in noxious microorganisms) together with the dissolving and neutralizing and deodorizing (e.g. organic and non organic compounds) of pollutants and polluted media take place.

Optically primitive form of non-imaging light concentrator, the light cone, has been used for many years [(Holter et al. (1962)]. During the years, the simple cone type optical concentrator has been evolved into complex structures that are more efficient (e.g. Compound Parabolic Concentrator (hereinafter called CPC), Compounded Ellipsoidal Concentrator (hereinafter called CEC). Optical concentrators such as the CPC have already demonstrated highly efficient harnessing and concentrating of solar energy collection, concentration, conversion and are well documented in fiber coupling applications.
Acoustic concentrators have also being used for generations throughout the evolutionary and progress of musical instruments such as the horn, flutes, organ, and trumpets as well as other instruments. Acoustic geometrical concentration in buildings, temples, churches and other architectural structures could be observed throughout history in both musical instruments and buildings.
Cone shape interfaces for concentrating the flow of liquids and gasses through particular conduit or chamber cross sections exist in many hydraulic and/or pneumatic system configurations.

The above mentioned optical and acoustic geometrical concentrators are used for separate purposes, i.e., optical concentrators for light concentration and acoustic concentrators for acoustic concentration and/or amplification, but are not used for both purposes simultaneously while having liquids or gasses flow throughout. Furthermore, the above mentioned concentrators were never used as hydrodynamic flow concentrators. More specifically, never before a compounded concentrator was used at the same time to enhance liquids and gasses flow and to concentrate electromagnetic and acoustic energies. The electromagnetic energy can be in any range of the electromagnetic spectrum, e.g. microwave, infrared, visible, ultraviolet etc. and the acoustic energy can be of any suitable frequency.

Surprisingly, it was found in the present invention, that using a compound concentrator as a concentrator or reactor through in which both electromagnetic and acoustic energies interact while passing at the same time liquids and gasses through the concentrator (single, and/or multi stage concentrator arrays) shaped reactor, enables disinfecting, and/or deodorizing and/or purification of said gasses and liquids with a very high throughput efficiencies.
In the context of the present invention Absorption is the process by which substances in gasses, liquid or solid form dissolve or mix with other substances (ASCE,1985)

In the context of the present invention Adsorption is the adherence of gas molecules, ions, or molecules in solution to the surface of solids (ASCEW, 1985).
In the context of the present invention Adsorption isotherm is a graphical representation of the relationship between the bulk activity of adsorbate and the amount adsorbed at constant temperature (after Stumm and Morgan, 1981).
In the context of the present invention Advection is the process whereby solutes are transported by the bulk mass of flowing fluid (Freeze and Cherry, 1979).

In the context of the present invention Air-space-ratio is the ratio of (a) the volume of water that can be drained from the saturated soil or rock under the action of force of gravity to (b) the total volume of voids (ASTM,1980).
In the context of the present invention Anisotropy is the condition of having different properties in different directions (AGI„ 1980).
In the context of the present invention Anisotropic mass is a mass having different properties in different directions at any given point (ASTM, 1980).

In the context of the present invention aquiclude is a hydrogeologic unit which, although porous and capable of storing water, does not transmit it at rates sufficient to furnish an appreciable supply for a well or spring (after WMO, 1974.

In the context of the present invention aquifer means a formation, a group of formations, or part of a formation that contains sufficient saturated permeable material to yield significant quantities of water to wells and springs (after Loh an and others, 1972). Means a geologic formation, group of formations to part of a formation capable of yielding a significant amount of ground water to wells or springs. Any saturated zone created by uranium or thorium recovery operations would not be considered an aquifer, unless the zone is or potentially is a) hydraulically interconnected to a natural aquifer b) capable of discharge to surface water, or c) reasonably accessible because of migration beyond the vertical projection of the boundary of the land transferred for long-term government ownership and care (10 CFR Part 40 Appendix A).
In the context of the present invention aquifer system is a body of permeable and poorly permeable material that functions regionally as a water -yielding unit; it comprises two or more permeable beds separated at least locally by confining beds that impede ground water movement but do not greatly affect the regional hydraulic continuity of the system; includes both saturated and unsaturated parts of permeable material (after ASCE, 1985).

In the context of the present invention aquifer test is a test to determine hydraulic properties of the aquifer involving the withdrawal of measured quantities of water from addition of water to a well and the measurement of resulting changes in head in the aquifer both during and after the period of discharge or additions (ASCE, 1985)

In the context of the present invention quifuge means a hydrogeologic unit which has no interconnected openings and, hence cannot store or transmit water (after WMO, 1974). A rock which neither contains no interconnected openings or interstices and therefore neither stores nor transmits water (ASCE, 1985).

In the context of the present invention baseline monitoring means that the establishment and operation of a designed surveillance system for continuous or periodic measurements and recording of existing and changing conditions that will be compared with future observations (after NRC, 1982).

In the context of the present invention breakthrough curve is a plot of relative concentration verses times, where relative concentration is defined as C/Co with C as the concentration at a point in the ground water flow domain, and Co as the source concentration.
In the context of the present invention, UV radiation is optical radiation from about 200nm - 400nm (e.g. such that are used to inactivate noxious microorganisms).

In the context of the present invention, visible radiation is optical illumination from 400nm to 700nm
In the context of the present invention, PDMS means polydimethilsiloxan. (which is used in elements through out (forming) devices according to the method of the present invention (e.g. forming elastic conduit and chambers).

In the context of the present invention resolved means synchronized to an accurate clock or time track (such as synchronizing laser, ultrasound probe, air flow, water flow, timed spectroscopy, oxygen mixing & melting time, radicals production and sustain time, pressure levels, peak power, pulse repetition rate, intensity, wavelength)
SUMMARY OF THE INVENTION

The present invention relates to a method for disinfecting and purifying liquids and gasses comprising; a) passing said liquids or gasses through a reactor or a combination of reactors, having a truncated compounded concentrator geometry; and b) simultaneously delivering and concentrating diversified electromagnetic and acoustic energies into a specific predetermined inner space of said compounded concentrator reactor, forming a high energy density zone in said reactor or reactors over a predetermined period of time.
The reactor according to the present invention is preferably a compounded parabolic concentrator or a compounded ellipsoidal concentrator.
According to method of the present invention the inner surface of the reactor is coated by a thin layer of photocatalyst such as TiO2.

The electromagnetic energy delivered and concentrated into and inside the reactor can be of any range of the electromagnetic spectrum, such as ultra-violet, visible, infra-red. microwave etc., or combination thereof.
The acoustic energy is of any suitable frequency.
The radiation source or sources delivering the electromagnetic radiation can be enclosed within the reactor or can be external to the reactor or a combination thereof.
The radiation source/s can be a laser, either continuous wave or a pulsed laser.

In a preferred embodiment of the present invention, the radiation unit having a high intensity source of light is a flash lamp having high repetition rate a from about 1 Hz to about 50 kHz, high peak power. From about 1 mJ to about 50Js.

The present invention further relates to a method wherein the liquids and gasses are passing thorough an array of at least two compounded parabolic reactors connected serially or in parallel or a combination thereof.
The present invention further relates to a device for use as defined according to said method wherein the device is a hollow truncated compounded concentrator having a wider inlet and a narrow outlet for the flow through of gasses and liquids and said concentrator has a specific predetermined optical concentrating geometry capable of concentrating light to form a high density energy zone therein. The concentrator inner shape can be a compound parabolic or ellipsoidal concentrator geometry or of any other compounded concentrator geometry.

The inner surface of the devices can be coated by photocatalyst, such as TiO2 (Titanium oxide). The inner surface can be coated by plasma spattering coating at a thickness from about 0.8 micron to about 1000 micro and can be applied on a substrate of SiO2 at a thickness of from 0.8 micron to about 1500 micron, thus forming a predetermined refractive index.
The refractive index of the coated material can be lower than the refractive index of the liquids or gasses which flow in the reactor.

The coated layers can have a plurality of grooves wherein said grooves are arranged in parallel or in a grid configuration and wherein the distance between two successive grooves is less then the length of a single incident wavelength upon it. The present invention further relates to a method and devices wherein the reactor is a part of a reverse osmosis system or a filtration system.

The present invention discloses a novel methodology wherein a plurality of energies interact in space and time, producing a high energy density zone, especially beneficial for disinfecting, dissolving and neutralizing pollutants in liquids and gasses (e.g. such as water & air). Further more, the method of the present invention facilitates continuous interaction of diversity of energies forming a high energy density zone. Such zone is particularly useful for:
(a) Disinfecting liquids and gasses
(b) Dissolving organic and/or non-organic compounds (e.g. such as polluting compounds)
(c) Normalizing and/or Neutralizing liquids and gasses therein innocuously maximizes perpetual output throughout.

(c) Catalytically and/or interactively impacting (d) a predetermined volume of diversified energies produced simultaneously within said geometry wherein liquids or gasses flow therein (or throughout) contain pollutants or noxious species and said pollutants are becoming more innocuous as a result of (e) Time resolved synchronized impact diversity of wavefronts for the purpose of forming maximized energy density of all wavefronts at a (predetermined) space or zone for disinfecting, dissolving and/or neutralizing or inactivating said volume of pollutants in said liquids or gasses over predetermined period of time. Furthermore, the Failure Modes Evaluation and Criticality Assessment (FME/CA) surpass. Limitations imposed by conventional systems using TiO2 optical catalyst wherein triggering rely heavily on the source of light (e.g. light must be present if triggering is to occur). The present invention utilizes harnessing and concentrating of both the laser light (190nm to about 315nm) and Ultrasound Transient Cavitation (21-180K-hz) which produces sonoluminecense in the regions of from 212nm to about 51 lnm hence the present invention is triggering the optical catalyst in more then one way increasing substantially the safety margins of devices according to the method of the present invention. The present invention disclose a novel methodology for concentrating different energies into a specific predetermined inner space, where liquids and/or gasses flow therein or throughout, having uniform high energy density zone for the purpose of inactivation of DNA and RNA replication sequences in noxious microorganisms and/or dissolving and neutralizing organic, non-organic and Disinfectant By-Products (DBPs). Further more, the present invention composedly harnesses compounded plurality of energy wavefronts together (e.g. simultaneously) in a single (e.g. a (HDCPC reactor) for disinfecting by creating a uniform dimensionally distributed high energy density zone within a conduit or chamber, (e.g. a reactor).

The present invention further relates to a method for disinfecting catalytically dissolving or neutralizing biological, organic and non organic pollutants and polluted media by interactively resolving the interoperability of optical peak power, acoustic transient cavitation and laser triggering of sub surfaced optical catalyst and all devices use thereof.

The present invention present a novel methodology wherein devices according to the method could integrate into existing pressure vessel (filtration systems) or could be
added before or after or be integral to said systems operating in the molecular and/or particulate filtration levels or any combination thereof. Further more, the present invention provide benefits, increasing the safety margins of existing filtration and purification systems (e.g. such as reverse osmosis, super filtration, membrane systems and larger particulate filtration systems)

This embodiment of the present invention provide an essential tool in which safe medical treatment and procedures could be provided substantially faster, safer reducing the dependency on expensive energy and/or time consuming processes (e.g. autoclaving, or use of Oxygen water and other solvents and toxic compounds) A doctor, surgeon, bio-technologist, dentist, agronomic specialist, researchers, teachers and multi-discipline practitioners could place instruments inside the holder such instruments could include; blades, laser components, mirrors, drilling accessories, ultrasound probes, sampling tools, needles and/or medical and/or industrial syringes.

claim.claim-text: CLAIMS:
1. A method for disinfecting and purifying liquids and gasses comprising;

Passing said liquids or gasses through a reactor or a combination of reactors, having a truncated compounded concentrator geometry; and Simultaneously delivering and concentrating diversified electromagnetic and acoustic energies into a specific predetermined inner space of said compounded concentrator reactor, forming a high energy density zone in said reactor or reactors over a predetermined period of time.
2. A method according to claim 1 wherein the reactor is a compounded parabolic concentrator.
3. A method according to claim 1 wherein the reactor is a compounded ellipsoidal concentrator.
4. A method according to claim 1 wherein the inner surface of the reactor is coated by a thin layer of photocatalyst.
5. A method according to claim 4 wherein the photocatalyst is TiO2.
6. A method according to claim 1 wherein the electromagnetic energy is in any range of the electromagnetic spectrum or combination thereof.
7. A method according to claim 1 wherein the acoustic energy is of any suitable frequency.
8. A method according to claim 1 wherein at least one of the sources of the electromagnetic energies is enclosed within the reactor.
9. A method according to claim 1 wherein at least one of the sources of the electromagnetic energies is external to the reactor.
10. A method according to claim 1 wherein at least one of the sources of the electromagnetic energies is a laser.
11. A method according to claim 10 wherein the laser is a pulsed laser.

12. A method according to t claim one wherein the radiation unit having a high intensity source of light is a flash lamp having high repetition rate a from about 1 Hz to about 50 kHz, high peak power. From about 1 mJ to about 50Js.
13. A method according to claim 1 wherein the liquids and gasses are passing through an array of at least two compounded parabolic reactors connected serially.
14. A method according to claim 1 wherein the liquids and gasses are passing through an array of at least two compounded parabolic reactors connected in parallel.
15. A method according to the claim one wherein the electromagnetic energy is a ultra-violet (UV) energy from about 200nm to about 400nm.
16. A method according to claim 15 wherein the UV radiation is pulsed

17. A compounded concentrator reactor device for use in the method as defined in any of the preceding claims wherein said reactor is a hollow truncated concentrator having a wider inlet and a narrow outlet for the flow through of gasses and liquids, and said concentrator has a specific predetermined optical concentrating geometry capable of concentrating light to form a high density energy zone therein.
18. A device according claim 16 wherein the concentrator inner shape is a compound parabolic or ellipsoidal concentrator geometry.
19. Devices according to claim 15, wherein the inner walls of the reactor are coated by photocatalyst.
20. A device according to claim 18 the photocatalyst is TIO2 (Titanium oxide).
21. A device according to claim 19 wherein the TIO2 is plasma spattering coated at a thickness from about 0.8 micron to about 1000 micron.
22. A device according to claim 20 wherein the TIO2 coating is applied on a substrate of SIO2 at a thickness of from 0.8 micron to about 1500 micron forming a predetermined refractive index.
23. A device according to clime 21 wherein the refractive index of the coated material is lower then the refractive index of the liquids or gasses which flow- in the reactor.

24. A device according to clime 16 to 22 wherein the coated layers has a plurality of grooves wherein said grooves are arranged in parallel or in a grid configuration and wherein the distance between two successive grooves is less then the length of a single incident wavelength upon it.
25. A device according to claim 17-24 wherein the reactor is a part of a reverse osmosis system or a filtration system.
26. A device as hereinbefore described and illustrated.
27. A method as hereinbefore described and illustrated.
